one_line: AI firms acquire startups, enterprise tools expand, new specialized models debut, and OpenAI releases policy blueprint.

themes.title: AI firms pursue strategic acquisitions
themes.text: Palo Alto Networks is negotiating a $500 million purchase of Clutch Security, while Dropbox plans to buy Tigris Data for $350 million, and OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company to add developer tools to Codex.

stories.headline: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI security startup Clutch Security for $500 million
Dropbox to acquire Tigris Data for $350 million to expand AI infrastructure
Dropbox to acquire AI storage startup Tigris Data for $350 million
OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer, adding developer tools to Codex

themes.title: Enterprise AI infrastructure gains new capabilities
themes.text: Box integrated Nvidia Nemotron embeddings to improve AI agent query accuracy, Mistral AI launched its Studio platform with the Le Chonk multimodal model, Nvidia announced full‑stack codesign improvements for memory efficiency, and its Vera CPU delivered higher agent throughput with better power use.

stories.headline: Box adds Nvidia Nemotron embeddings to boost enterprise AI agent queries
Mistral launches Studio Le Chonk platform for enterprise AI deployment
Nvidia uses full‑stack codesign to boost AI memory efficiency
Nvidia vera cpu offers higher agent throughput and better power efficiency

themes.title: Specialized AI models launched this week
themes.text: OpenAI introduced GPT‑6 Cyber for vulnerability detection, Google DeepMind released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash for 15‑second video generation, and Nvidia provided four open‑weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for interactive simulation.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT‑6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model for finding vulnerabilities
Google DeepMind launches Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model with 15-second clips
Nvidia adds four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for interactive simulation

themes.title: OpenAI outlines community compute policy
themes.text: OpenAI published a National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to guide responsible AI infrastructure development and local resource protection.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint
